title.es: Un fin de semana en el extranjero

phrase.es: Pasamos el fin de semana en el extranjero.

text.ru: Договорённость на ближайшее будущее — Present Continuous: We're spending the weekend in Rome. abroad — без предлога: go abroad, live abroad (не to abroad).
text.en: For fixed plans in the near future, use the Present Continuous: We’re spending the weekend in Rome. abroad takes no preposition: go abroad, not to abroad.
text.es: Planes cercanos: Present Continuous — We’re spending the weekend in Rome. abroad sin preposición: go abroad.

examples.en: We're flying to Lisbon on Friday.
examples.ru: В пятницу мы летим в Лиссабон.

examples.en: How much did you spend on the trip?
